{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders removed: {len(qa_orders)}')

df_clean = df[~df['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Filter out refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Confirm final population
print(f'Final population size: {len(df_clean)}')

# Check distribution of channels and customer_segment
df_clean[['channel', 'customer_segment']].value_counts()"}
